column4: Extremely large run-segment totals no longer wrap into false values; ordinary totals and raw history are preserved.
Recovered individual source-backed changes for all 132 retained historical APKs, including tests and internal changes, while identifying failed attempts and the private delivery alias.
Added six permanent checks for overflow, exact boundaries, cancellation, provenance and 1,000 independently calculated sample sequences.
Added four permanent checks for every historical number, changed-file coverage, native sprites, record fingerprints and large sections.
Added emulator checks and screenshots for the 275-entry Build 22 section, Build 37 and Codex TEST67 without dropping any icons.
Build checks now require every changed source, test, resource, tool and configuration file to have reviewed change notes, including complete diffs larger than 300 files.
Verification now checks every compiled historical record against its reviewed contents and validates all required screenshots.
Added a read-only APK census, inspected retained packages and corrected artifact downloads while reusing successful evidence.
Private publication now derives its tag and APK filenames from the verified build number instead of copied filenames.
Recorded TEST67 delivery, the protected publication failure, complete history evidence and the verification request in the development documents.

I reconstructed each retained APK's changes from its own predecessor instead of combining builds. The history includes individual testing and internal changes, with explicit records for failed attempts and the mislabeled private delivery.
